description: Scored US and global macro briefs from official public data (FRED, BLS, BEA, World Bank): economic regime, inflation, labor market, rates and yield curve, bank credit stress, commodities and supply chain, housing, consumer health, Treasury auction demand (TreasuryDirect), US fuel supply (EIA), trade flows by partner, business formation (Census), and 8-country comparisons of the economy, governance and stability, health systems and education. Each brief is a 0-100 score with label, trend versus the horizon, the inputs that drive it, risk flags, confidence and a citation for every input. Includes a CPI inflation calculator. POST /v1/brief {vertical} returns one scored brief; POST /v1/overview returns every brief at once; POST /v1/verticals lists them. Verticals: macro-regime (Is the US economy strengthening or weakening, and why?); inflation (Is inflation pressure building or easing?); labor (How strong is the US job market?); rates (Are financial conditions tightening, and is the yield curve inverted?); credit-stress (Is consumer or bank credit stress rising?); commodities (Are energy, metals and freight adding cost pressure?); global-compare (How do these economies compare on growth, inflation and jobs?); housing (Is US housing heating up or cooling down?); consumer (How strong is the US consumer: spending, income and credit?); country-risk (How stable and well governed is each of these countries?); health-systems (How do these countries compare on health outcomes and health spending?); education (How do these countries compare on education access and investment?); yield-curve (What shape is the Treasury curve, and is it inverting or steepening?); bank-health (Are bank failures or consumer complaints about banks rising?); global-rates-fx (Where are ECB rates, euro area inflation and the major currencies versus their history?); treasury-demand (Is demand for US government debt weakening?); energy-supply (Are US fuel supplies tight, and are pump prices rising?); trade-flows (Is the US trade deficit widening, and with which partners?); business-formation (Are Americans starting businesses faster or slower than usual?). Raw scored series: /v1/signals, /v1/signal, /v1/explain, /v1/catalog. Every response is a single JSON object. Research signal, not investment advice.

rpc_types.notes: POST /v1/verticals, POST /v1/brief, POST /v1/overview, POST /v1/signals, POST /v1/signal, POST /v1/explain, POST /v1/catalog, POST /v1/inflation/adjust; GET /v1/version, /v1/health. JSON body only. Bad input returns 400 + JSON.

serving.backend: Node.js HTTP server (zero npm dependencies) behind a RelayMiner at http://<container>:8080. No caller auth. Answers come from a private hub refreshed by a scheduled collector of official public data; 5-minute cache.
serving.notes: Gateway operators: configure as type passthrough with rpc_types ["rest"].
